title: 限る and 限り
summary: 限る means to limit; its noun 限り is the edge of a boundary, and many set phrases come from that image.

blocks.text: The verb **限る** means to limit, and its い-stem noun **限り** means the limit, the edge of a boundary. Most of the phrases in this lesson come from that one image.

rows: as far as / as long as

blocks.text: 限る = limit, so **Noun に限る** first means "limited to that noun".
Push the idea to the extreme and it becomes "X is the pinnacle, nothing goes beyond it": X is the best.

blocks.jp: 暑い日はかき氷に限る。
blocks.en: On a hot day, nothing beats shaved ice.

blocks.text: 限り, the noun, also means the extreme. With 声の ("of the voice") it means "the very limit of your voice".

blocks.en: (I) called at the top of my voice.

blocks.text: Of all (people / times): に限って
**Noun に限って** picks one person or time out of all the others, often with surprise or bad luck.

blocks.jp: 彼に限って、そんなことはしない。
blocks.en: He, of all people, would never do such a thing.

blocks.jp: 急いでいる時に限って電車が遅れる。
blocks.en: It is just when I'm in a hurry that the train is late.

blocks.text: Not limited to: とは限らない
A statement + **とは限らない** denies it as always true: "it is not necessarily the case".

blocks.jp: 高い物が良い物だとは限らない。
blocks.en: Expensive things are not necessarily good things.

blocks.text: The modifier fills the noun 限り: "to the limit of what I know".

blocks.jp: 私の知る限り、そんな店はない。
blocks.en: As far as I know, there is no such shop.

blocks.text: その場限り: for that occasion only
その場 is "that spot" and 限り is the limit, so something is limited to that moment and does not carry on.

blocks.jp: 約束はその場限りだった。
blocks.en: The promise held only for that occasion.

blocks.jp: けんかはその場限りにしよう。
blocks.en: Let's not let the quarrel outlast the moment.

items: **Noun に限る** = limited to, or the best.
**Noun に限って** = of all (people / times).
**Modifier + 限り** = as far as / as long as.

options: Nothing beats ice cream in summer
Ice cream is forbidden in summer
Ice cream is sold only in summer
questions.note: に限る = it reaches its limit at ice cream, the best.
questions.en: In summer, nothing beats ice cream.

questions.instruction: What does とは限らない express?
questions.note: It denies "always".
The literal meaning of limiting.

questions.prompt: 彼に限って嘘はつかない。
options: He of all people wouldn't lie
questions.note: He is the extreme of people who would not.
questions.en: He, of all people, doesn't lie.

questions.instruction: What is 限り in terms of the verb 限る?
questions.note: An い-stem makes a noun.

questions.prompt: 限り can be used to say "as far as I know".
questions.note: 私の知る限り.
It is a denial of always.

questions.instruction: What does その場限り imply?
options: It only counts for that occasion
questions.note: Limited to the moment.

questions.prompt: あの人＿＿、そんな悪いことはしない。
questions.note: に限って means "of all people".
questions.en: That person, of all people, would never do such a bad thing.

questions.prompt: 寒い日は、温かいラーメン＿＿。
questions.note: Noun に限る ends the sentence: nothing beats it.
questions.en: On a cold day, nothing beats hot ramen.

questions.note: だとは限らない denies that something is always true.
questions.en: Rich people are not necessarily kind.

questions.prompt: 私が知っている＿＿、この町に図書館はない。
questions.note: Modifier + 限り means as far as.
questions.en: As far as I know, there is no library in this town.

questions.note: に限って picks out just those times.
questions.en: It's just when I go out that it rains.

questions.instruction: Tap the phrase that means "not necessarily"
questions.note: とは限らない denies it is always the case.
questions.en: Big dogs are not necessarily strong.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that means "as long as"
questions.note: Modifier + 限り: as long as.
questions.en: As long as I live, I'll study Japanese.

questions.prompt: I'll help as far as I can.
questions.note: Modifier + 限り: as far as I can.
questions.en: I'll help as far as I can.

questions.prompt: Nothing beats a hot bath in winter.
questions.note: Noun に限る ends the sentence.
questions.en: Nothing beats a hot bath in winter.

questions.prompt: Cheap things are not necessarily bad.
questions.note: とは限らない: not necessarily.
questions.en: Cheap things are not necessarily bad.

questions.prompt: 彼女に限って約束を忘れない means that she, of all people, would not forget a promise.
questions.note: に限って picks out one person.
questions.en: She, of all people, would not forget a promise.

questions.instruction: What does 限り mean here?
options: At the top of my voice
questions.note: 限り is the extreme: the very limit of the voice.
questions.en: (I) sang at the top of my voice.

questions.instruction: Which sentence says "That's not necessarily true"?
questions.note: とは限らない is the not-necessarily pattern.

questions.instruction: What does 限り mean here?
questions.note: Modifier + 限り: as far as I can.
questions.en: I'll go as early as I possibly can.
